fields.v: No (0): only two sources (DBLP titles, arXiv abstracts) with search date; queries in the supplement; no reference-list or citation search, preprints excluded; authors acknowledge possible misses
fields.quote: On September 22, 2026, we searched DBLP titles and arXiv abstracts for terms related to software, harnesses, and agentic tools.
fields.where: §III Reporting of Agentic Coding Tool Studies, p. 3
fields.why: Under the usual DARE scoring (Kitchenham), a search of up to two digital libraries with no extra search strategy scores No, not Partly; the protocol gives no other rubric.
fields.doubt: A pesquisa usa só duas fontes (DBLP, só títulos, e arXiv) e não faz pesquisa nas referências nem nas citações (pág. 4). Na escala DARE de Kitchenham isto costuma dar Não. Decide se manténs Parcial (a DBLP cobre quase toda a informática) ou passas a Não.
